name: fix-main-integration-scope-and-parent
body: `domain.entity.main-integration` models the NAVIGATOR's raw git use alone — rebasing inside the worktree. The agent-builder's commit of `.opencode/agents/**` on main and the optional release-agent's push/tag are separate carve-outs outside change-set integration. The entity sits under `domain.group.agent-fs-operations`, beside its sibling `domain.entity.worktree-write-boundary`, because both are boundaries on where and how agents mutate repo state; `domain.group.agent-roster` classifies distributed versus generated agents rather than mutation surfaces.
